title: Q-DISCLOSE-spec-tooling: specification tooling runs with or without the private specification
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** Q-DISCLOSE-check; public CI has no private specification to read
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation disclosure --tooling
**Status:** closed

`scripts/spec_ids.py`, `scripts/check_license.py`, `workers/tools/spec_truth.py`, `workers/tools/req_ids.py`, `workers/tools/spec_backlog.py` and `workers/core/conformance/cli.js` read the specification directory from `ULTRASTABLE_SPEC_DIR` (or their existing flag). With the directory present they run in full mode and change nothing about today's checks. With it absent they run in registry mode: requirement IDs against `doctrine/spec-ids.json` and the committed conformance manifest, and every check that needs the text reports `unmeasured`, never `ok`. `disclosure --tooling` runs each tool against an empty directory and requires every one to exit without a traceback and without a false pass.

**Prediction:** disclosure.spec_tools_failing_without_spec <= 0 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** rewriting git history (the ruleset refuses force pushes); changing the platform's agents/AGENTS.md, which every repository fetches by public URL (AGENT-BOOTSTRAP-1); moving the company papers already in ultrastable/ops admin/. Weakening any requirement or any probe to make a tool pass.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation disclosure --tooling` exits 0 on main. It fails today: the command does not exist.


**Evidence:** closing probe passed (2 consecutive passes after a recorded failure): disclosure tooling ok: every specification tool reports unmeasured without the text
